description: Calling for Expressions of Interest from interested investors for the Caustic Soda/Chlorine project in Paranthan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-09-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Paranthan Chemicals Limited has already completed a feasibility study for the resumption of the Caustic Soda/Chlorine manufacturing plant at the premises where the Paranthan Chemical Factory was located and plans are being prepared to establish the factory at that location in the future. Paranthan Chemicals Limited currently imports chlorine and distributes throughout the country and since the total amount of chlorine required for the country's water treatment is imported, there is a risk of the entire water treatment system being disrupted in the event of disruptions to global supply chains. Also, the establishment of a chlorine production plant in the country has been identified as a nationally important task to ensure water security by minimizing the foreign exchange spent on chlorine import. It is also expected that the implementation of the proposed project will create about 95 direct employment opportunities and about 2,000 indirect employment opportunities. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Industry and Entrepreneurship Development to call Expressions of Interest from local and foreign investors interested in implementing the proposed project as a Public Private Partnership project on the 30-acre land allocated to Paranthan Chemicals Limited from the land where the said company was located, was approved by the Cabinet.
